Long, voluminous platinum blonde hair styled in loose curls. Warm, bright gold eyes with a benevolent, motherly expression. Appears to be in early adulthood with a refined maturity. Slender, statuesque build. An elegant, flowing white gown with gold embroidery and a long, translucent veil. Includes a massive, complex mechanical rigging system featuring aircraft launch decks and a wide, flat mechanical tail.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
